meta.name: api-design-reviewer
meta.description: Comprehensive REST API design review with automated linting, breaking-change detection, and design scorecards. Catches inconsistent conventions, missing versioning, and design smells before APIs ship. Use when reviewing a PR that adds or changes API endpoints, auditing an existing API for v2 migration, or establishing API standards for a team.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 审查 API 设计规范,自动检测破坏性变更
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果经常评审 API 变更或制定团队接口规范
copy.tagline_en: Review API design, detect breaking changes automatically
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you frequently review API changes or set team API conventions

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会审查 REST API 设计，运行三个脚本：检查命名、HTTP 方法等规范，检测版本间的破坏性变更，并给 API 设计质量打分（A-F）。
howto.when: 当你提交或修改 API 端点的 PR、审计现有 API 准备 v2 迁移、或为团队制定 API 标准时触发。

say.text: 帮我审查这个 OpenAPI 规范文件。
say.note: Claude 会运行 linter 并报告问题。

say.text: 比较两个版本的 API 规范，找出破坏性变更。
给这个 API 设计打分，要求至少 B 级。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude reviews REST API designs by running three scripts: linting for naming and HTTP method conventions, detecting breaking changes between spec versions, and scoring design quality (A-F).
howto.when_en: Triggered when reviewing a PR that adds or changes API endpoints, auditing an existing API for v2 migration, or establishing API standards for a team.

say_en.note: Claude runs the linter and reports issues.

say_en.text: Compare two API spec versions and find breaking changes.
say_en.note: Claude runs breaking_change_detector and lists changes.

say_en.text: Score this API design, require at least grade B.
say_en.note: Claude runs scorecard and gives grade with suggestions.
